prompt: Water-level view from a rowing skiff at night, 24mm, very close: a gaunt man of about 65 with grey stubble and hollow cheeks, hatless, in a soaked dark overcoat, sits at the oars with his hands low, his face three-quarter and filling the top half of the frame. Behind him the crew's own speedboat, set alight to destroy the evidence, burns against a timber pier, and the pier has caught: tall orange flames, sparks climbing. The black harbour water mirrors the whole blaze upside down in one long smear. A violet mercury tube on the next wharf, out of frame right, lights the near side of his face and his mouth; orange rims his wet hair. Thanks.
